data.heading: 1-mashq — Tanlovli fe'llarni to'g'ri tanlang
steps: Researchers are investigating why chocolate provokes / induces headaches in certain people.
Wilson's most recent paper has motivated / generated a great deal of interest among sociologists.
The drug triggered / facilitated headaches and dizziness among a number of subjects in the test.
Having an end-of-term prize contributes / motivates students to do well in their class tests.
Intensive farming has contributed to / provoked the decline of bird populations.
The missile test stimulated / provoked an immediate and very strong response from neighbouring governments and from the United Nations.

narr: Bu mashqda sizga berilgan gaplardagi to'g'ri fe'llarni tanlash kerak. Har bir gapda ikkita variant berilgan bo'lib, siz ularning ma'nosiga qarab to'g'risini tanlashingiz kerak.
Birinchi gapda 'provokes' yoki 'induces' fe'llari berilgan. 'Induces' so'zi ko'pincha tibbiy kontekstda sabab bo'lish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.

Ikkinchi gapda 'motivated' yoki 'generated' fe'llari berilgan. 'Generated' so'zi biror narsaning ro'y berishiga yoki mavjud bo'lishiga sabab bo'lish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
Uchinchi gapda 'triggered' yoki 'facilitated' fe'llari berilgan. 'Triggered' so'zi boshlab yuborish, odatda to'satdan va salbiy narsani boshlash ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
To'rtinchi gapda 'contributes' yoki 'motivates' fe'llari berilgan. 'Motivates' so'zi ularni ijobiy biror ishni qilishga undash ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
Beshinchi gapda 'contributed to' yoki 'provoked' fe'llari berilgan. 'Contributed to' so'zi ta'sir etuvchi omillardan biri bo'lish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
Oltinchi gapda 'stimulated' yoki 'provoked' fe'llari berilgan. 'Provoked' so'zi sabab bo'lish, odatda salbiy narsaga sabab bo'lish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.

data.heading: 1-mashq — Tanlovli fe'llarni to'g'ri tanlang (cont.)
steps: Astrologers believe that people's lives are motivated / determined by the planets and stars.
The barrier inhibits / induces the flow of water into the area to prevent flooding in the rainy season.
A leak in the tank stemmed from / accounted for 40% of the fuel loss, and evaporation took away another 5%.
The renovated college buildings have wider doors to influence / facilitate the use of wheelchairs.
The Minister cut taxes in an attempt to stimulate / trigger the economy, which was performing poorly.
Britain has facilitated / derived many economic benefits from membership of the European Union.
data.result: Javob: (1) induces (sabab bo'ladi, ko'pincha tibbiy kontekstda); (2) generated (biror narsaning ro'y berishiga yoki mavjud bo'lishiga sabab bo'ldi); (3) triggered (boshlab yubordi, odatda to'satdan va salbiy narsani); (4) motivates (ularni ijobiy biror ishni qilishga undaydi); (5) contributed to (ta'sir etuvchi omillardan biri bo'ldi); (6) provoked (sabab bo'ladi, odatda salbiy narsaga); (7) determined (uni belgilovchi asosiy omil); (8) inhibits (ularning boshqa holatda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidan kamroq erkin bo'lishiga to'sqinlik qiladi); (9) accounted for (tushuntiradi); (10) facilitate (osonlashtiradi); (11) stimulate (biror narsaning rivojlanishiga yoki ishlashiga sabab bo'ladi); (12) derived (biror narsa natijasida olinadi).

narr: Yettinchi gapda 'motivated' yoki 'determined' fe'llari berilgan. 'Determined' so'zi belgilovchi asosiy omil bo'lish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.

Sakkizinchi gapda 'inhibits' yoki 'induces' fe'llari berilgan. 'Inhibits' so'zi ularning boshqa holatda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidan kamroq erkin bo'lishiga to'sqinlik qilish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
To'qqizinchi gapda 'stemmed from' yoki 'accounted for' fe'llari berilgan. 'Accounted for' so'zi tushuntirish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
O'ninchi gapda 'influence' yoki 'facilitate' fe'llari berilgan. 'Facilitate' so'zi osonlashtirish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
O'n birinchi gapda 'stimulate' yoki 'trigger' fe'llari berilgan. 'Stimulate' so'zi biror narsaning rivojlanishiga yoki ishlashiga sabab bo'lish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.
O'n ikkinchi gapda 'facilitated' yoki 'derived' fe'llari berilgan. 'Derived' so'zi biror narsa natijasida olinish ma'nosida ishlatiladi, shuning uchun bu javob to'g'ri.

data.heading: 2-mashq — Gap boshlanishlarini va yakunlarini moslashtiring
data.problem: Quyidagi gap boshlanishlarini yakunlari bilan moslang:
steps: 1 The article explores the origins —
2 One small explosion set off a chain —
3 The confusion probably stemmed —
4 The proposed new tax could have —
5 The disastrous events of 2003 gave —
6 The judge explained that there were —
data.result: Javob: 1 — d (The article explores the origins of the concept of democracy); 2 — e (One small explosion set off a chain reaction, causing massive damage); 3 — f (The confusion probably stemmed from a lack of communication); 4 — a (The proposed new tax could have major consequences for larger families); 5 — c (The disastrous events of 2003 gave rise to a widespread sense of disillusionment); 6 — b (The judge explained that there were precedents for his decision).

narr: Bu mashqda sizga gap boshlanishlari va yakunlari alohida berilgan. Ular to'g'ri moslashtirib, to'liq gaplarni hosil qilishingiz kerak.

Birinchi gap boshi 'The article explores the origins —' bo'lib, uning to'g'ri yakuni 'd — of the concept of democracy' bo'ladi. Demak, to'liq gap: 'The article explores the origins of the concept of democracy.'

Ikkinchi gap boshi 'One small explosion set off a chain —' bo'lib, uning to'g'ri yakuni 'e — reaction, causing massive damage' bo'ladi. Demak, to'liq gap: 'One small explosion set off a chain reaction, causing massive damage.'

Uchinchi gap boshi 'The confusion probably stemmed —' bo'lib, uning to'g'ri yakuni 'f — from a lack of communication' bo'ladi. Demak, to'liq gap: 'The confusion probably stemmed from a lack of communication.'

To'rtinchi gap boshi 'The proposed new tax could have —' bo'lib, uning to'g'ri yakuni 'a — major consequences for larger families' bo'ladi. Demak, to'liq gap: 'The proposed new tax could have major consequences for larger families.'

Beshinchi gap boshi 'The disastrous events of 2003 gave —' bo'lib, uning to'g'ri yakuni 'c — rise to a widespread sense of disillusionment' bo'ladi. Demak, to'liq gap: 'The disastrous events of 2003 gave rise to a widespread sense of disillusionment.'

Oltinchi gap boshi 'The judge explained that there were —' bo'lib, uning to'g'ri yakuni 'b — precedents for his decision' bo'ladi. Demak, to'liq gap: 'The judge explained that there were precedents for his decision.'

data.heading: 3-mashq — Gaplarni yetishmayotgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring
data.problem: Quyidagi gaplarni yetishmayotgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring. Bitta gapda bir nechta so'z qo'shish shart emas:
steps: De Routa's work in the 1970s influenced ___ the development of computer science.
The acid seemed to have no ___ whatsoever on the plastic, which remained unchanged.
Everyone hoped that the outcome ___ the meeting between the two governments would be a new and better trade agreement.
The reason ___ the failure of the project was a lack of funding.
The impact of global warming ___ the polar ice caps is now understood more clearly.
There is no precedent ___ this kind of decision.
data.result: Javob: (1) so'z kerak emas — influenced to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi oladi (Her grandmother influenced Sarah's choice of career); (2) effect (have no effect whatsoever on the plastic); (3) of (the outcome of the meeting); (4) for (the reason for the failure of the project); (5) on (the impact of global warming on the polar ice caps); (6) for (there is no precedent for this kind of decision).

narr: Bu mashqda sizga berilgan gaplarni to'ldirish uchun to'g'ri so'zlarni tanlashingiz kerak. Ba'zi gaplarda so'z kerak bo'lmaydi.
Birinchi gapda 'influenced' so'idan keyin so'z kerak emas, chunki bu fe'l to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi oladi. Masalan: 'Her grandmother influenced Sarah's choice of career.'
Ikkinchi gapda 'no' so'zidan keyin 'effect' so'ini qo'shish kerak. To'liq gap: 'The acid seemed to have no effect whatsoever on the plastic, which remained unchanged.'

Uchinchi gapda 'outcome' so'zidan keyin 'of' prepozitsiyasini qo'shish kerak. To'liq gap: 'Everyone hoped that the outcome of the meeting between the two governments would be a new and better trade agreement.'
To'rtinchi gapda 'reason' so'zidan keyin 'for' prepozitsiyasini qo'shish kerak. To'liq gap: 'The reason for the failure of the project was a lack of funding.'
Beshinchi gapda 'global warming' so'zidan keyin 'on' prepozitsiyasini qo'shish kerak. To'liq gap: 'The impact of global warming on the polar ice caps is now understood more clearly.'
Oltinchi gapda 'precedent' so'zidan keyin 'for' prepozitsiyasini qo'shish kerak. To'liq gap: 'There is no precedent for this kind of decision.'
